name: Flashforge AD5X 0.4 nozzle Low Waste
printer_notes: Low-waste 0.4 mm preset for the Flashforge AD5X. Select process "0.20mm Standard Low Waste @FF AD5X" with this printer. Purge in prime tower is on, so color-change purge can be laid into infill and supports. The prime tower stays on, which that feature requires.
